question.text: What proportion of directors of the Investment Manager of an InvIT should be independent?

explanation.text: The Logic: As per the InvIT Regulations, not less than half of the directors of the Investment Manager (in case of a company) or members (in case of an LLP) should be independent. They should also not be directors/members of an Investment Manager of another InvIT. The Trap: "Not less than one-third", "All directors must be independent" and "Not less than two-thirds" are not the proportion specified by the InvIT Regulations for the Investment Manager's board. Note: Source — NISM-Series-III-C workbook (January 2026), page 302, which sets the "not less than half" independent-director/member requirement for the Investment Manager of an InvIT.
